summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new 'Payment (SO)' page (OfficeFlow dispatch). Verified: admin login, sidebar nav item + /dashboard/dispatch/payment-so route, officer list columns (Client Name / SO Name / SO Code) with seeded 'John Doe / ARS297002 / Arseas Security', officer search (by code -> 1 row, junk -> 0 rows), row click -> report view (so-report-view), Add Payment dialog from BOTH the list row button (stopPropagation works, list stays) and the report view button, 6 payment methods in dropdown (W2, W9, Zelle, Cash, Direct Bank Transfer, Others), save -> POST 200 -> row appears and total/per-method balances recompute ($1350.50 -> $1475.75, new 'Paid via Direct Bank Transfer $125.25'), required-field validation toast, method filter (Zelle -> 2 rows / $600.00), combined date_from+method filter (-> 1 row / $100.00), Reset (clears both date and method, total restored), Summary box (client/officer/code/statement period/TOTAL BALANCE/per-method), PDF download (3145 bytes) and XLSX download (5733 bytes), and delete payment (confirm -> DELETE 200 -> row removed, total recomputed). All 7 requested flows PASS. No console errors, all /api/so-payments/* calls returned 200.

integration_issues.flow: Dispatch realtime websocket (pre-existing, unrelated to Payment SO)
integration_issues.issue: Console warning on every dashboard load: WebSocket connection to 'wss://<host>/api/ws/dispatch' failed. Non-blocking.

design_issues.screen: Payment (SO) - Add Payment dialog & Report filters
issues: Date fields use native <input type=date> (browser default mm/dd/yyyy picker) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component used elsewhere - inconsistent styling and shows raw 'mm/dd/yyyy' placeholder.
Delete payment uses native window.confirm() instead of a shadcn AlertDialog - inconsistent with app UX and not testable via data-testid.

action_items: Optional polish: replace native date inputs with the shadcn calendar picker in AddPaymentDialog and report filters
Optional polish: replace window.confirm delete with an AlertDialog
Note: a stray payment record (2026-08-26 / Cash / txn '123' / $500.00) exists on John Doe from earlier manual/curl testing - remove if it was not intended seed data
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentSOPage.savePayment only triggers a report refresh when the report is open for the same officer; adding a payment from the list view does not invalidate anything else - acceptable but worth noting if list-level aggregates are added later.
State hook `const [reloadReport, setReloadReport] = useState(0)` is declared after savePayment uses it (hoisting-safe but fragile ordering); move hook declarations to the top of the component.
seed_data_creation: Created a temporary payment (2026-06-15, Direct Bank Transfer, TXN-QA-001, 125.25) and deleted it via the UI delete button as part of the delete test. No residual QA data.
